tagline: Tempo-synced arpeggiator for held MIDI notes
description: Turns held chords into a stepped sequence of single notes at a tempo-synced rate, replacing the incoming notes with the arpeggio. Use it on a MIDI track ahead of any instrument to turn sustained chords into rhythmic patterns. Built as a MIDI effect, so Ableton Live will not load it; use a host that accepts third-party MIDI effects.

features.name: Six patterns
features.description: Up, Down, Up-Down, Down-Up, Random and Played Order.

features.name: Rate
features.description: Nine step lengths from 1/1 to 1/32, including 1/4, 1/8 and 1/16 triplets, timed from the host tempo.

features.name: Octave range and gate
features.description: Repeats the pattern over 1 to 4 octaves; Gate sets note length from 0 to 100% of a step.

features.name: Latch
features.description: Keeps the arpeggio running after the keys are released.

features.name: Velocity
features.description: Uses the average velocity of the held notes, or a fixed velocity from 1 to 127.
